title: Territory Sales Representative - Northern Midwest Region
description:

Who We Are
At Pelican, we engineer products that stand up to the world’s toughest conditions-because the people who rely on us do too. For nearly 50 years, we’ve been a trusted partner for military personnel, first responders, outdoor adventurers, and innovators who push the limits.
With a global presence that includes 11 offices, 4 manufacturing facilities, and 4 custom case centers, we create high-performance protective solutions that ensure our customers can focus on what matters most. Whether it’s transporting critical medical supplies, securing mission-essential equipment, or keeping expedition gear safe, Pelican products are Built to Protect to Equip for the Mission.
At Pelican, your work has a real-world impact. You’ll be part of a team driven by innovation, craftsmanship, and the shared belief that when the mission is critical, failure isn’t an option. If you’re ready to build something that makes a difference, be part of a team that protects what matters most.
What You'll Do:
As a Territory Sales Representative, you’ll grow Pelican’s business across the Northern Midwest by building customer relationships, developing new opportunities, and expanding existing accounts. This remote, field-based role offers the autonomy to manage your territory while representing trusted Pelican products to dealers, distributors, and end users.

• Own and grow the Northern Midwest territory by developing relationships with dealers, distributors, and end users.

• Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships to drive revenue growth.

• Partner with dealers and channel partners to increase market share and strengthen customer partnerships.

• Provide product training and educational sessions for dealers, customers, and sales partners.

• Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique:

• Remote, Midwest-Based: Work remotely while managing your territory across the Northern Midwest, with a preference for candidates located within the region.

• Opportunity to own and grow a large geographic territory.

• Direct exposure to customers, dealers, and industry partners across Northern Midwest.

• Ability to represent premium products with a strong reputation in the marketplace.

• High visibility role with significant impact on regional growth and business development.

What We’re Looking For:

• 1-2 years of sales experience.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• SAP experience is a plus.

• Working knowledge of sales techniques and business development.

• Ability to develop strong knowledge of Pelican products, the assigned territory, and company sales strategies.

• Excellent verbal and written communication, persuasion, and presentation skills.

• Ability to build relationships, identify opportunities, and work independently in a remote, field-based environment.

Work Location & Territory:
This is a remote, field-based position supporting the Northern Midwest, including:

• Minnesota

• Wisconsin

• Illinois

• North Dakota

• South Dakota

title: Photographer (Remote in Finland)
description:
Work Location: Remote within Finland
Engagement Model: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Preferred availability: 20 hours per week or more

Estimated Project Duration: 1-2 months

Compensation: Task-based

Induction and work coordination hours are compensated with $30.

Production time is compensated for per item: $1.5 per picture. With an average throughput per hour of 20 images, the average compensation per hours is $30.

Productivity bonus plan: Additional $100 for each 1k pictures that pass quality checks.

Role Summary

The Photographer is responsible for capturing and submitting high-quality, unedited RAW images that meet project specifications.

This role requires daytime availability and the ability to consistently meet weekly productivity expectations.

Role Responsibilities

• Capture high-quality native RAW images. Produce both:
-RAW Images: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device.
-Image Pairs: pairs of identical unedited photos, with specific objects present in one and absent in the other photo.

• Ensure images are: unedited, original, not AI-generated, aesthetically pleasing, and visually interesting with an intent behind the composition.

• Ensure compliance with location eligibility requirements for public and non-public images.

• Maintain a consistent weekly production target of a minimum of 400 images per week. The productivity requirement is 20 RAW images per hour.

• Upload images to the working platform.

Role Requirements

• 18+ years old and resident of Finland

• Education or certification in the photography field is a plus.

• Demonstrable photography experience. Strong portfolio preferred.

• Must own a full-frame mirrorless/DSLR or APS-C mirrorless/DSLR camera and a tripod

• Ability to work independently and meet productivity and throughput expectations.

• Self-motivated, quick learner and organized

• Quality and detail-oriented mindset

• Reliable internet access for uploading large RAW files.

• Provide a sample of 5 RAW images including EXIF data during the application process.

• If selected to move forward, complete a short test by submitting 10 sample images for skill and device verification. Detailed instructions on how to complete this step will be shared.

description:
Join our team and you’ll be responsible for delivering workforce insights and driving data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics, AI and scalable reporting solutions.
Working in the People Analytics department, you will partner with People Partners and senior stakeholders to improve workforce planning, data quality and organisational effectiveness.
You will play a vital role as we reimagine the labour market to make it work for everybody.
Your responsibilities:

•
Advanced Analytics, AI & Insights: Analyse workforce trends across hiring, retention, engagement, performance and organisational effectiveness. Apply statistical, predictive and scenario-based methods, leverage AI, evaluate People initiatives and identify opportunities to improve workforce outcomes and planning.

•
People Reporting & KPI Governance: Develop KPI definitions, reporting standards and governance. •

Penguin Random House Christian Publishing Group
In editorial, when a book proposal is received, the editor decides whether or not to pursue it for acquisition. An editor works with the author to turn the manuscript into a finished book. description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Ottawa
Job Location: Work at Home, Illinois, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

• Support and drive national publication strategies and scientific communication activities.

• Help establish medical governance, SOPs, and compliant ways of working in Italy, appropriate for a growing biotech organization.

Cross-Functional & External Leadership

description:
We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

PLATFORM ENGINEERING

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

WORKFLOWS & DATA PIPELINES

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

DATA MODELING & VISUALIZATION

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

MAPS & GEOSPATIAL DATA

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

ROADMAP CREATION AND IDEATION

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl http://deck.gl, or similar) is a big plus.

Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus.

Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus.

Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. As a leader at Backblaze, you will work across the organization to help achieve our reliability and operational goals, including partnering with engineering leaders, executives, customers, and other key stakeholders. The Right Fit

•
10+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure, or production operations, including significant engineering leadership experience.

•
Demonstrated experience building, managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing technical teams.

•
Experience leading reliability or infrastructure org

title: Chemical Engineer @Diluvian (backed by Hexa)
description:
About Diluvian

Diluvian builds containerized atmospheric water generators (10ft units) that produce drinking water from ambient air,

off-grid, for defense, mining and remote industrial sites. The company is incubated by Hexa, the Brussels-based

venture studio, and the first units go into the field in the coming months.

Why MOFs

Our first units run on a proven silica-gel desiccant, so we can ship fast and learn from real deployments. The next

step is metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). Water-stable MOFs such as aluminium fumarate (e.g. Basolite A520)

show a steep uptake step at low-to-mid relative humidity and regenerate at lower temperature than classical

desiccants. That could mean more litres per kWh and per kg of sorbent, especially in arid conditions. Your role is to

turn that potential into validated, system-level data that drives our next unit generation.

What you'll do

• Co-design and build a water sorption test setup (humidity-controlled chamber, cycling bench, instrumentation) with

our engineering team

• Source and benchmark commercial MOFs (e.g. BASF, Promethean Particles, NovoMOF) against our silica-gel

baseline

• Measure water sorption isotherms, adsorption/desorption kinetics and regeneration temperature under realistic

conditions (temperature, RH, cycle times)

• Run accelerated cycling tests (hundreds to thousands of cycles) to quantify capacity loss and structural stability

• Explore shaping and integration: pellets, binders, coatings on heat-exchanger or wheel supports, and the

performance hit each implies

• Check water quality: metal and linker leaching against EU drinking water limits (Directive 2020/2184)

• Translate results into system-level numbers (L/kWh, L/kg sorbent/day, €/kg at scale) and clear material

recommendations for our engineering team

How we work

• Freelance, part-time, over the coming weeks and months; evenings and weekends are fine

• You won't build alone: our engineering team supports you hands-on on test-rig design, hardware and

instrumentation

• Characterization runs in partner labs we have access to; you help decide which tests are worth running where

• You set your own experimental plan and milestones, and own the results. We provide context, budget and fast

decisions

• You'll work directly with Diluvian's founders, Quentin Van Overmeere (CTO) and Arnaud Biebuyck (CEO)

Who we're looking for

• MSc in chemistry, chemical engineering or materials science; PhD students and recent graduates welcome

• Hands-on lab experience, ideally with porous materials, adsorption or materials characterization (DVS, BET, XRD,

TGA)

• High agency: you design the experiments, drive them to results, and tell us what the data means

• Bonus: familiarity with sorption-based AWG literature (MOF-801, MOF-303, Al-fumarate) or thermal systems

About the Internet Society Foundation
The Internet Society (ISOC) supports and promotes the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society. Our work aligns with our goals for the Internet to be open, globally connected, secure, and trustworthy. We seek collaboration with all who share these goals.
Together, we focus on building and supporting the communities that make the Internet work; advancing the development and application of Internet infrastructure, technologies, and open standards; and advocating for policy that is consistent with our view of the Internet.
The Internet Society Foundation (Foundation) is a non-profit organization that works in concert with the Internet Society . It exists to demonstrate and support the positive difference the Internet can make to people everywhere and promote the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society.
The Foundation is committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion, where all individuals are valued for their distinct contributions. Our people are the most valuable strengths we have. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, inventiveness, innovation, self-expression, unique capabilities and talent that our staff invests in their work represents a significant part of not only our culture, but our reputation and the Foundation's achievements.

title: Lead Design Engineer - Structural Steel
description:

Eaton 's Data Center Solutions division is seeking a Lead Design Engineer - Structural Steel with proven expertise in tubular steel structure design, analysis, and documentation for data center whitespace infrastructure. This is a specialist-level individual contributor role who bring independent analytical rigor, code-level structural calculation fluency, and direct experience designing the structural systems that support overhead power, cooling, containment, and cable management infrastructure within live and new-build data center environments.
The expected annual salary range for this role is $97,000 - $143,000 a year.
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What we offer:

Eaton 's Data Center Solutions division is at the center of one of the most capital-intensive infrastructure build cycles in history - powering and cooling the compute that runs AI, cloud, and enterprise applications worldwide. This Engineering Specialist role offers a structural engineer with a consulting background the opportunity to apply deep technical expertise inside a product and manufacturing organization: influencing how structural systems are designed, standardized, and scaled across thousands of data center deployments.

Eaton provides a comprehensive benefits package including competitive base salary, annual performance incentive bonus, medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and access to Eaton 's learning and development platforms.

What you’ll do:

• Design and analyze structural systems for data center whitespace infrastructure, including power distribution, containment systems, cable management, cooling equipment supports, and modular assemblies.

• Perform structural engineering calculations, member sizing, connection design, and load analysis for gravity, seismic, lateral, and dynamic loading conditions.

• Develop complete structural calculation packages, including load assessments, deflection checks, anchorage design, and supporting documentation for design reviews and approvals.

• Evaluate complex assemblies using structural analysis tools (e.g., SAP2000, FEA software) and validate results with engineering judgment and hand calculations.

• Assess and modify existing infrastructure for retrofit, upgrade, and capacity expansion projects, ensuring structures can safely support new loads.

• Create and coordinate structural drawings and BIM/Revit models, including fabrication details, installation plans, clash detection, and multi-discipline coordination.

• Support new product development by collaborating with mechanical and MEP teams, providing structural input, risk assessments, design-for-manufacturing feedback, and testing requirements.

• Serve as the structural engineering expert for customers, contractors, engineers of record, and regulators, supporting delegated design submittals, technical reviews, project proposals, and site-specific solutions.

This role could be the next step in your career if you demonstrate the following experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Civil, or Structural Engineering from an accredited institution

• Minimum of five (5) years of structural engineering or engineering mechanics experience.

You will set yourself apart by demonstrating some or all of the following:

• Master's degree in Structural Engineering with thesis or research focus in steel structures, connection design, or structural dynamics.

• PE (Professional Engineer) licensure preferred

• Direct experience designing overhead whitespace infrastructure for data centers: containment frames, busway and cable tray support structures, cooling pipe support systems, and related

The Engineering Academy is designed to accelerate your tech career at Vinted. This intensive, hands-on programme features training sessions led by our very own experts, who will mentor and guide you through our technology and ways of working.

We’re looking for people with some coding skills and a passion for all things engineering - those who are just starting their careers in this area and are eager to learn, grow, and make an impact.

When?

Our  Spring   Engineering Academy begins on March 1, 2027 . You will be expected to be available full time (0.8 contract option for University students is possible).

• Improve our user experience by implementing product changes, often via experimentation.

title: Legal Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role:

World-class legal AI is built on world-class legal data. Getting that right is one of the most critical and complex challenges at Legora.

Every jurisdiction holds billions of pages of critical legal text scattered across hundreds of sources - statutes, case law, regulatory guidance, secondary materials, and more. Only about 3% is publicly accessible on the web. The rest is buried across courts, agencies, and archives. Getting this right doesn't just improve a product feature - it shapes how lawyers around the world navigate legal information for the next several decades.

As a Legal Data Analyst at Legora, you will own this challenge. You will be the person who is responsible for mapping the legal source ecosystem, determining and prioritizing what we go after, and how this content shall be structured and systematized - the one who makes sure we actually get legal data right. Few roles at the company will have more direct impact on Legora AI’s ability to navigate the law correctly.

What you will be doing:

- Map the legal data landscape across key jurisdictions - structuring how statutes, case law, secondary sources, and regulatory content interrelate, building a clear picture of what exists, where it lives, and how it connects

- Conduct deep dives into individual sources, assessing available material, document types, commercial value, and the legal preconditions for data acquisition

- Prioritise data acquisition based on client demand, user value, and Legora's broader data coverage strategy

- Serve as the critical link between legal knowledge and our engineering teams - translating the nuances of each source into actionable briefs that enable our engineers to get the most out of every dataset

- Own the quality and accuracy of the legal data layer that underpins Legora's global legal research product

Who you are

- You are a detail-oriented lawyer with an exceptional track record - academically, professionally, or both

- You are excited about what AI is doing to the legal industry and you want to be close to that shift

- You find legal source theory and jurisdictional complexity genuinely interesting - the kind of lawyer who has always enjoyed digging deep and doing extensive research

-

- You are thorough and precise, with a natural attention to detail

What’s in it for you:

- The legal data infrastructure you help build will be what lawyers across the world use to navigate law for the next several decades - this is foundational work, not a feature ticket

- Career development opportunities in one of the fastest growing AI companies in the world

title: People Operations Generalist
description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Abridge is looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our People team and keep our core People Ops work running smoothly: onboarding, benefits, workers’ comp, compliance, and HR support tickets. You’ll work closely with the Head of People Operations and the rest of the People team to keep things running smoothly and build processes that keep up as we scale.

This role suits someone who is proactive, moves fast, and brings solutions instead of questions. They’re resilient when priorities shift, comfortable with ambiguity, and have a bias for action. They enjoy owning the details, switching between tasks easily, and want to help scale People Ops at a fast-growing startup.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

HR Support & Systems

- Triage and respond to employee questions in our HR ticketing system quickly and accurately, and escalate when needed.

- Use Rippling day to day to manage employee data and pull reports. Spot data issues and fix them before they cause problems.

- Find recurring ticket themes and turn them into self-serve resources or process fixes.

Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle

- Own new hire onboarding from offer to first day, including paperwork, Rippling setup, and coordination with IT on devices and access.

- Make sure every new hire has a smooth, well-organized experience, and keep improving the experience as hiring accelerates.

Benefits & Workers’ Comp

- Administer employee benefits, including enrollments, qualifying life events, open enrollment, and renewals, and be the first point of contact for employee benefits questions.

- Manage workers’ compensation claims from start to finish.

Compliance

- Manage compliance programs, including audits, harassment prevention training, and other regulatory mandates.

- Lead compliance reporting requirements such as EEO-1 and state-specific filings, making sure submissions are on time and accurate.

- Maintain internal documentation (policies, calendars, audit trails) and build scalable processes that can flex with our team’s growth.

- Support audits and respond to regulatory inquiries with thorough, organized documentation and clear processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Work with Payroll, Legal, Finance, and IT to give employees a seamless experience.

- Jump in wherever there’s an operational gap, and help bring clarity and structure as we grow.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 3-5 years of experience in People Operations, HR Generalist, or HR Coordinator
